decision: UX-31 replaces the earlier contain-scroll rule: an inner scroll area passes leftover scrolling to its parent at its edge, with the trackpad gesture latched to the area it began in

decision: nested_scroll(id, child) makes the returned div the scroll area and child its content; it keeps its ScrollHandle in keyed element state. nested_list(id, state, list) does the same for a virtualized GPUI list. Both run one rule, a11y::route
why: chaining needs the inner area's offset and range before the event, and an opaque child that scrolls on its own exposes neither; a probe painted after the area runs before it in GPUI's bubble order, and the wrapper's listener runs after it, so the area can be put back when the page owns the gesture
evidence: apps/dory-gpui/src/a11y.rs; tests/scroll_chain.rs fails 3 of 3 with contain_scroll and 3 of 3 with no wrapper

decision: the scroll latch is kept per nested area: Started resets it, the first moving event decides Inner or Parent, momentum keeps it until the next Started, and a mouse wheel (line deltas) drops it
why: GPUI reports trackpad momentum as Moved with no end marker, so the next Started is the only reliable gesture boundary; each area sees every event in the window, so it knows a gesture began elsewhere
evidence: a11y::route unit tests; gpui-pre-macos events.rs maps NSEventPhase None to Moved

decision: the transcript list's 80 pt dock clearance moves from the list's own padding to a wrapper, and the list is 80 pt shorter

decision: Queue order is (priority, place, id) with a per-job place that starts as the enqueue time; JobEvent::Place sets it and resets the priority; Pipeline::move_job permutes the existing places of the queued jobs in one apply
why: Priority is only Normal or Front, so no arbitrary order and no second Move to Top; permuting existing places keeps new enqueues at the back and Cancel then Retake keeps the spot for Undo
evidence: crates/dory-core/tests/facade.rs move_job tests; store contract a_placed_job_is_picked_in_its_new_spot on MemStore and SQLite; schema v5 migration test

decision: Dory's own modal dialog host on GPUI Base's Dialog replaces Kit's open_dialog for Set Up Summaries
why: Kit 0.9.1 cannot name a dialog for VoiceOver and paints its own 10% shadow after any style, so neither the title as accessible name nor shadow_float is reachable through Kit's theme
evidence: gpui-component-0.9.1 dialog.rs dialog_shadow applied after refine_style; tests/a11y_tree.rs now fails on any unnamed dialog and finds Set Up Summaries named

decision: Kit menus (Export, ⋯, Filter, row menu) stay Kit PopupMenus restyled through theme::sync: popover fill surface_raised, text, scrim, dialog radius; edge and shadow stay Kit's
why: replacing Kit menus means rebuilding keyboard navigation, submenus, and checks; Kit draws the menu edge as foreground at 10% and a fixed shadow, and its accent token also colors ghost-button hover, so the accent highlight would break the trigger buttons
evidence: gpui-component-0.9.1 styled.rs popover_style and popover_ring; button.rs Ghost hover uses tokens.accent

decision: Light surface_border is #C3C7CF and contrast.rs holds it to 1.5:1 on the surface in standard light, 3:1 on the surface, the dimmed window, and scrim_opaque in dark and Increase Contrast
why: operator's decision in floating-surfaces.md: light relies on the white fill and the shadow; #C3C7CF is 1.2:1 on the dimmed light window

decision: The Processing window is a WindowKind::Floating window with a transparent titlebar and the dialog header beside the traffic lights; its origin is saved in ui-prefs.json as processing_origin
why: operator's decision: non-modal, floating, remembered position, like Activity Monitor's
evidence: tests/queue.rs command_w_and_close...; tests/prefs.rs round trip; visual pass queue-*.png

decision: Finished this session is built in AppState from jobs that leave the queue between reloads, read as Done or Cancelled from the row's newest job; Undo of a cancel is pipeline().retry, which keeps the job's place
why: no core read lists terminal jobs by session; the queue diff sees every job the app watched finish
evidence: tests/queue.rs cancel_acts_at_once_and_undo_restores_the_old_position; facade cancel then retry test

decision: Card and window Move to Top go through Pipeline::move_job(job, 0), not Promote
why: two Move to Tops in a row now work; a job already first in line is a no-op instead of a Front flag

decision: VoiceOver custom actions for reordering are not built
why: GPUI 0.3.12 exposes no accesskit custom actions, only on_a11y_action for standard actions; the ⋯ menu carries Move to Top, Move Up, Move Down, and Cancel instead
evidence: rg custom_action in gpui-pre-0.3.12 finds nothing

decision: closing the main window destroys it and keeps AppState in a Main global; Show Dory, the Dock icon, a notification click, and a quit that asks reopen it with open_main_window
why: GPUI on macOS does not quit when the last window closes (QuitMode::Default), and recreating the window is testable with TestAppContext where hiding an NSWindow is not

decision: Quit is an app-wide action; with nothing in progress it quits at once, otherwise a Quit Dory? dialog in the main window with Cancel focused; every quit shuts the core down first, off the main thread
why: the window-level handler left Quit disabled whenever focus was outside the main window; a clean shutdown seals the take and leaves jobs and downloads to resume
evidence: quit.rs prompt tests; quit_and_menu_bar.rs quit tests

decision: the Dock's Quit, logout, and restart cannot ask; an on_app_quit hook shuts the core down synchronously so they still save the take
why: GPUI answers applicationShouldTerminate itself and has no cancellable hook; adding a method to GPUIApplicationDelegate at runtime was not worth the risk

decision: the menu-bar title reads Dory · while jobs run or wait, and VoiceOver reads Dory, processing
why: a small activity mark the coordinator suggested; nothing else marks background work when the window is closed
evidence: status_item.rs title test; not yet seen in the real menu bar

decision: notification settings live in ui-prefs.json as the kinds turned off; should_post is a pure table of kind, main window state (closed, behind, key), and settings
why: the UI owns when to notify, not the core; storing only what is off keeps old files all-on

decision: Book ships behind Settings › General › Theme › Try the Book theme, off by default; the Book card and View › Theme › Book show only once it is on
why: spec section 5 and the brief agree: ship Book behind a setting off by default; no conflict to ask about

decision: Modern's tokens are pinned by a golden file written from the code before themes (32 variants: 8 accents x light/dark x Increase Contrast)
why: the brief requires proof Modern is unchanged; a golden diff names the exact token that moved

decision: Book's byline keeps Modern's meta-line words, set in serif italic 16; the spec's example sentence is not used
why: UX-20 says a theme never changes what any text says; the example's wording differs from the meta line
